environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING override to COUNT, (2) a custom rule 'block-order-dir-injection' with priority 1 that uses a RegexPatternSet matching the pattern (?i)(;|--|union|select|insert|update|delete|drop|exec|xp_|0x|char\() applied to SingleQueryArgument 'dir' with action BLOCK, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default BLOCK action. The ALB forwards to the ECS target group on port 8080. Additionally, the task role has no S3 or external network access (VPC with no NAT gateway, no internet gateway on the task subnet, only VPC endpoint for ECR and CloudWatch Logs).
